annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de la Presidencia, Justicia y Relaciones con las Cortes (Spain)
key_provisions_or_claims: Completes EU UAS Regulations 2019/945, 2019/947 and U-Space 2021/664 in Spain, and regulates non-EASA public-authority UAS activities (police, customs, SAR, firefighting).
Sets minimum ages for operators and remote pilots and mandatory insurance for UAS of 20 kg or more and for certain categories.
Creates the Ministry of Interior UAS aircraft registry linking aircraft to owners, with sale and transfer registration duties.
Defines general UAS geographical zones (military, critical infrastructure, urban, aerodromes) and procedures for particular zones and U-Space.
Regulates training entities and instructors for remote pilots and designates AESA as competent authority for airworthiness, personnel and operations.
annotation.summary_en: Spanish Royal Decree 517/2024 (consolidated text) develops the civil legal regime for unmanned aircraft systems, complementing EU drone regulations. It covers operator ages, insurance, public-authority non-EASA operations, training entities, geographical zones, U-Space competences and a Ministry of Interior drone registry, and amends several related decrees.
annotation.title_clean: Real Decreto 517/2024, de 4 de junio, por el que se desarrolla el régimen jurídico para la utilización civil de sistemas de aeronaves no tripuladas (UAS)
annotation.title_en: Royal Decree 517/2024 of 4 June developing the legal regime for the civil use of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS)
